All concept figures (both zh and .en PNGs), A3/A0 PDF boards (zh+en), and offline HTML viewers were authored by the submitter for this package. Figures were rasterized with Python Pillow using macOS STHeiti (system font, not redistributed); PDFs were rendered from self-authored HTML via headless Chrome. English PNGs are independently rasterized with translated labels and are not byte-copies of the Chinese files. See report/copyright_statement.md for the full asset-level ledger.

HTML/CSS references fonts by family name only (PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft YaHei, Heiti SC, STHeiti, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif). No third-party font file is bundled, subsetted, or redistributed in the package. Rasterized PNGs use macOS STHeiti Light/Medium already installed on the authoring machine; font software itself is not shipped.

sources.usage: The '烨脉 / Ye Pulse' wordmark, the forked-cursor node motif and the JZ-01…JZ-06 project names are original concept proposals by the author. They are not derived from any third-party logo, are explicitly not an approved government brand, and must be cleared separately if used outside the review context.

The package contains no external map tiles, no aerial or satellite imagery, no proprietary basemap, no traced third-party map, no Font Awesome / Material Icons / Noun Project icons, and no embedded code snippets or model weights. All spatial shapes are authored as GeoJSON; all diagram shapes are raw CSS/SVG. Third-party institution or company names appearing in the narrative (universities, enterprises, operators) are descriptive nominative references only and do not imply endorsement.
